title: Device chat erase: take in what another tab saved before answering
evidence: Found 2026-11-26 in the review of US-11 AC13. On this device, packages/health-core/src/chat-session.ts eraseAll writes nothing when this tab's chat copy holds no conversation, so a conversation another tab saved after that copy was read stays in storage while deleteUserData (widget-src/src/lib/roadmap-data.ts) answers chat 'erased'. The words can then say the chat history was deleted. A fix must not create a chat-history.json where none exists (US-11 AC2; the iPhone shares this code).
